_meta.inclusion_rule_quoted: Inclusion: a peer-reviewed article or preprint (conference abstracts and theses excluded) that models intergranular or intra-particle interface fracture in a layered-oxide cathode (NMC, NCM, NCA, LiNiO₂, LiCoO₂, Ni-rich) and gives a numeric GB or interface strength, with any symbol.
_meta.exclusion_rule_quoted: Exclusion: GBs not represented explicitly (homogenised or effective properties, or a single pre-placed cohesive surface); interface fracture energy only, without a strength; core–shell or cathode–electrolyte interfaces; non-layered materials; reviews.
_meta.screen_rule: Title-only (plus year from the log; venue absent from the log, so venue=null). Conservative: a title that plausibly describes a layered-oxide (NMC/NCM/NCA/LCO/LNO) polycrystal fracture MODEL with GBs/interfaces, or whose material is unstated but could be one, is include_for_fulltext. The numeric-strength clause of S1 cannot be tested at title level and is left to full text. borderline=true marks calls a second screener could reasonably flip.

reason_codes.INCLUDE_PLAUSIBLE_LAYERED_OXIDE_GB_FRACT: Title plausibly describes a fracture MODEL of a layered-oxide (or unspecified) cathode/particle with grain boundaries or internal interfaces; cannot be excluded on title alone. Sent to full text.
reason_codes.ALREADY_IN_RECORD: DOI (or its arXiv preprint id) is already present in review_b01.json; list name given in in_record_list. Decision field carries the title-level verdict.
reason_codes.NOT_LAYERED_OXIDE_CATHODE: Fracture/GB/cohesive work on a non-battery material (metals, alloys, ceramics, graphene, rock, concrete, composites) or a generic method with no battery material named; or a non-layered / non-Li-layered cathode chemistry. S1: non-layered materials excluded.
reason_codes.NOT_INTERGRANULAR_OR_INTERFACE: Battery-particle fracture model without GBs/internal interfaces in the title (single crystals, homogeneous particle). S1: GBs not represented explicitly excluded.
reason_codes.NOT_FRACTURE_MODEL: Layered-oxide/cathode modelling or analysis whose title names transport, chemo-mechanical response or degradation but not fracture/cracking/debonding.
reason_codes.EXPERIMENTAL_ONLY: Cathode materials/electrode work without a fracture model in the title: synthesis, coating, doping, characterization, electrochemistry, electrode design.
reason_codes.CORE_SHELL_OR_CATHODE_ELECTROLYTE_INTERF: Fracture of core-shell or cathode-electrolyte interfaces; explicitly excluded by S1.
reason_codes.SOLID_ELECTROLYTE_ONLY: Solid-electrolyte topic with no layered-oxide cathode fracture.
reason_codes.ANODE_OR_OTHER_BATTERY_TOPIC: Battery work not on layered-oxide cathode fracture: anodes, Li metal, liquid electrolytes, SEI, Li-S, separators, recycling, safety, processing.
reason_codes.REVIEW_OR_NON_ARTICLE: Review, perspective, roadmap, encyclopedia entry, thesis, conference/meeting abstract, peer-review report or decision letter. S1: reviews, theses, conference abstracts excluded.
reason_codes.SUPPLEMENTARY_FILE: DOI is a supplementary-information component (suffix .s00x) of an article, not an article itself; none of these titles would pass the screen.
reason_codes.NO_TITLE: Title field empty in the search log; cannot be title-screened (see rationale).
